contentHtml:
Hyderabad: NATCO Pharma Limited has announced the launch of Carboplatin Injection, a generic version of Paraplatin, in the US market through its US subsidiary, NATCO Pharma USA LLC.

The product is being launched in collaboration with Chennai-based Teyro Labs Pvt Ltd to help address a critical shortage of the drug in the US market.

Carboplatin Injection is indicated for the treatment of advanced ovarian carcinoma. Its uses include first-line combination therapy and palliative treatment of recurrent disease in patients who have previously undergone chemotherapy.

According to NATCO Pharma, Carboplatin Injection recorded estimated US sales of $27.8 million for the 12 months ended June 2026, based on industry sales data.

The launch strengthens NATCO Pharma’s presence in the US generics market, where the company focuses on pharmaceutical products with limited competition. The company has a research-driven business spanning generic and branded medicines, specialty pharmaceuticals, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and crop protection products.

Headquartered in Hyderabad, NATCO Pharma operates nine manufacturing sites and two research and development facilities in India. Its manufacturing facilities have approvals from several regulatory authorities, including the US Food and Drug Administration (USFDA), Brazil’s ANVISA, Health Canada and the World Health Organization (WHO). The company supplies products to more than 50 global markets.

Carboplatin Injection is a prescription medicine. Healthcare professionals should consult the full prescribing information for approved indications, limitations of use and important safety information.

NATCO Pharma Limited is an India-based pharmaceutical company engaged in developing, manufacturing and distributing generic and branded pharmaceuticals, specialty medicines, APIs and crop protection products. The company focuses on research-driven pharmaceutical development, oncology and targeted therapies, alongside products for domestic and international markets.
